chunks: And among them is he who says: 'Our Lord, give us in this world [that which is] good and in the Hereafter [that which is] good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.'

key_terms.الْآخِرَةِ: the Hereafter, the life to come

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the supplication 'Rabbana atina' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often contrasted with the supplication of the righteous (2:202) to distinguish between general believers seeking holistic well-being and the pious who seek divine proximity above all else. The term 'hasanah' is interpreted by scholars like Al-Tabarsi as encompassing both material prosperity and spiritual elevation, reflecting the Shia emphasis on balancing dunya and akhirah rather than renouncing the world. This supplication serves as a model for daily du'a, illustrating the comprehensive scope of divine mercy for those who seek it with sincerity.
